evals.prompt: Hey, just got back from a client lunch. Here's the receipt from The Capital Grille — it's a PDF I saved from their email. Date on it is January 15, 2026, total was $187.40. Please file it for me in Google Drive. (Simulate the Google Drive interaction — describe exactly what you would do step by step, what the folder path would be, and what the final filename would be.)
evals.expected_output: Claude should extract: date=2026-01-15, vendor=The_Capital_Grille, amount=187.40. Filename should be The_Capital_Grille_187.40.pdf. It should look for 'Bishop AI finances' at the root of My Drive, then check/create a '2026-01-15' subfolder. Final confirmation should show the folder path and a link format.
assertions: The proposed filename is 'The_Capital_Grille_187.40.pdf' (or similar with underscores, no dollar sign, correct extension)
The destination folder path includes 'Bishop AI finances / 2026-01-15'
The response mentions checking whether the 2026-01-15 folder already exists before creating it
The response includes a confirmation with the folder name and describes where to find the link

evals.prompt:
I'm uploading three receipts from last week — process all of them:
1. Amazon order confirmation (screenshot, PNG): March 5, 2026, $34.99
2. Starbucks receipt (phone photo, JPG): March 7, 2026, $8.75
3. Another Starbucks (phone photo, JPG): March 7, 2026, $6.50

File all of them in Google Drive please. (Simulate the full process for each one.)
evals.expected_output: Claude should process each receipt independently. Amazon → Amazon_34.99.png in folder 2026-03-05. Both Starbucks receipts → Starbucks_8.75.jpg and Starbucks_6.50.jpg in the same existing 2026-03-07 folder (not creating duplicate date folders). Three separate confirmation blocks, one per receipt.
assertions: Amazon receipt is routed to a '2026-03-05' subfolder
Both Starbucks receipts are routed to a '2026-03-07' subfolder (not two separate folders for same date)
The second Starbucks receipt reuses the existing 2026-03-07 folder rather than creating a new one
File extensions are preserved (.png for Amazon, .jpg for Starbucks)
No dollar signs appear in any of the proposed filenames
Three separate confirmation blocks are provided, one per receipt

evals.prompt: I have a crumpled receipt photo (JPG) where the date is blurry and I can't make it out clearly. The vendor name looks like 'FedEx Office' and the amount is $22.13. What happens when you try to file this?
evals.expected_output: Claude should stop processing and ask the user to provide the date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It should NOT proceed to create folders or upload until the date is confirmed. It may note the vendor (FedEx_Office) and amount (22.13) it extracted, but must ask about the date first.
assertions: Claude stops and asks the user to provide the date before proceeding
The question asks for the date in YYYY-MM-DD format specifically
Claude does NOT attempt to create a folder or upload the file without a confirmed date
Claude acknowledges the vendor name (FedEx Office or FedEx_Office) and amount ($22.13 or 22.13) it was able to read
